code_label: Fully connected QuGAN for finance
text_span: We develop a fully connected Quantum Generative Adversarial network and show how it can be applied in Mathematical Finance
rationale: Summarizes the main contribution and application domain.

code_label: Focus on volatility modelling

code_label: Quantum GANs introduced to improve accuracy

code_label: Paper builds a fully quantum GAN

text_span: The quantum circuit will equivalently consist of stages, where at each stage 1 we only work with the first qubits
